text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: emphatic accusative particle opening a long delayed-predicate enumeration
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens an emphatic claim but delays its resolution through the whole six-group list. The reader has to hold the entire human taxonomy before the second {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) brings the divine separation clause. Its first beat also belongs to the ayah's larger three-beat architecture: inventory, verdict, and witness-warrant.

topics.headline: emphatic inventory held open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first emphatic particle makes the whole list grammatically suspended until the divine verdict arrives.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an opening inna-clause whose long governed subject is resolved by the later divine judgment clause.

topics.headline: three emphatic beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move through three asserted stages: listed communities, divine separation, and universal witness.
topics.reason: The same particle recurs at words 1, 16, and 22, matching the CRITICAL claim that the ayah is staged by repeated emphatic openings.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun forming an action-defined class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not start the list with a bare label. It makes the first group depend on the following act of believing, and this relative-pronoun frame recurs at words 5 and 14 around the nominal middle groups. The list therefore alternates between communities defined by finite actions and communities named by established labels.

topics.headline: first group defined by an act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first community is grammatically defined by what it has done, not merely by a name.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun heads a relative clause whose verb supplies the class-defining content.

topics.headline: relative clauses frame labels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's list as patterned, with relative-clause groups framing the named middle labels.
topics.reason: The three relative pronouns occur at words 2, 5, and 14, bracketing the sequence of definite nominal community labels.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural: they believed or entered trust, with no explicit local object
words.root_gloss_range: safety, trust, faith, security, and entrusting; local Form IV selects believing or committing trust rather than bare safety
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is a perfect plural act, so the first listed community is defined by completed commitment. Because no object is expressed, the grammar foregrounds the belief or trust-act itself rather than narrowing it to one stated complement. The root field of safety and trust still matters: the Form IV does not mean merely being safe, but it makes faith feel like a voluntary entrusting. This opening also recalls the older community formula in 2:62 and 5:69, while 22:17 expands that formula by adding Magians and associators; within this surah the same believer root returns under guidance language at 22:54.

topics.headline: completed belief with object unstated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is defined by a completed act of believing while the object remains unspoken.
topics.reason: The aligned word is a 3mp perfect Form IV verb used intransitively in this clause.

topics.headline: safety root becomes trust commitment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels belief here as entrusting commitment, while the local Form IV keeps the selected sense away from bare safety.
topics.reason: The root field includes safety and trust, but the surface Form IV and local intransitive use select believing or committing trust.

topics.headline: expanded inherited list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this opening as part of the 2:62 and 5:69 community-list formula, now expanded in 22:17 and linked to the same-surah believer guidance statement at 22:54.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references for the recurring community formula and the same-surah believer root return.

topics.headline: audible action-defined peers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first, second, and final action-defined groups as peers through the shared plural-perfect ending.
topics.reason: The row links the plural perfect endings of the three finite verbs that define the relative-clause communities.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the second relative group into the same governed list

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening emphatic particle governing the long enumeration

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the opening believers from a sole topic into the first member of a coordinated list. It attaches the next relative-clause group under the same first {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) without apposing or collapsing the two communities.

topics.headline: second group added without collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the list begins as a parity chain: the second group is joined to the same judgment frame while remaining distinct.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the next relative phrase into the same inna-governed enumeration.

words.gloss_range: second relative pronoun defining the Jewish group through the following verb
words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) repeats the action-defined frame instead of giving a bare ethnic or communal label. Its following verb supplies the identity, aligning this group with the opening believers and the final associators as finite-action communities.

topics.headline: second group defined by verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second group is also made into an action-defined class rather than a standalone label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces a clause whose finite verb defines the group.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural intransitive: they became or were Jews, not they guided an object
words.root_gloss_range: guidance, return, turning, and led movement; local use selects communal identification while retaining directional undertone

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening action-defined belief/trust verb in the list

words.prose: {{ar:هَادُوا۟}} ({{tr:hādū}}) is an intransitive perfect plural, so the verse is not saying that this group guided someone else. It names a completed communal identity. The wider root field of guiding, returning, and led movement gives the label directional pressure, but the local form keeps the sense on those who became or were Jewish. In the recurring community list it holds the second slot after {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) as in 2:62 and 5:69, and the same root crossing from divine guidance in 22:16 to human identity here sharpens the boundary between guidance and judged affiliation.

topics.headline: completed Jewish identity, not guiding another
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb marks a completed identity-state rather than an act of guiding an object.
topics.reason: The QAC and valency evidence mark the verb as perfect plural and intransitive in this local clause.

topics.headline: guidance root narrowed to affiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a directional root-field behind the label, while the local grammar keeps communal affiliation as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root carries guidance and return meanings, but the surface verb in this formula functions as a communal designation.

topics.headline: formula slot and guidance boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word both as the fixed second member in the 2:62 and 5:69 list and as a same-root shift from divine guidance in 22:16 to judged identity in 22:17.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallel references and the immediate boundary contrast.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction admitting the Sabian nominal label into the governed list
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) brings the Sabian label into the same governed enumeration and marks the list's shift from relative-clause identities to definite nominal labels. The rare group is not treated as an aside; the connector gives it coordinate status under the coming verdict.

topics.headline: rare label coordinated into list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both the transition to nominal community names and the equal inclusion of the rare Sabian label.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the following definite noun with the preceding inna-governed groups.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle plural community label, accusative in the list
words.root_gloss_range: rare field involving emergence, star-rising, and religious departure; local form turns that into a stable community designation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣābiʾīna}}) carries the list's accusative coordination while shifting into a definite nominal label. Its rare root field joins emergence and religious departure, and the active-participle form turns that movement into an identity-state rather than a finite action. The label is locked to the community-list cluster of 2:62, 5:69, and 22:17, with 22:17 expanding the cluster beyond its earlier set. The internal hamza break is a small but real sound payoff in the otherwise smooth coordinated sequence.

topics.headline: stable nominal identity in the governed list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare active-participle label is grammatically absorbed into the same judgment set.
topics.reason: The word is tagged as a definite masculine plural active participle in accusative coordination.

topics.headline: emergence and departure become identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Sabian label with emergence and religious-departure pressure, while the local form keeps it as a community name.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports emergence/departure imagery, but the Quranic occurrences are nominal community labels.

topics.headline: rare formulaic recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this rare label as part of the specific community-list cluster in 2:62, 5:69, and 22:17.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify the restricted distribution and concrete parallel references.

topics.headline: internal hamza interruption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a brief articulatory interruption inside the flowing list, matching the label's rare profile.
topics.reason: The sound row names a concrete phonetic feature of the local surface.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the Christian label as the next nominal community
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the Christian label as another coordinate after the Sabians. The conjunction keeps the move from a rare marginal label to a major communal label from becoming a hierarchy or explanation; both remain members of the same list.

topics.headline: another nominal group, same rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Christians added as a coordinate peer rather than as an explanation or replacement for the preceding group.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the next definite nominal group into the same enumeration.

words.gloss_range: definite Christian community label, accusative in the enumeration
words.root_gloss_range: help, support, aid, victory, and affiliation; local use is the Christian label while support resonance remains audible

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening emphatic particle governing the long enumeration

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-naṣārā}}) is a definite community noun in the middle of the list, not another relative clause. Its irregular shape does not remove it from the accusative chain governed by the opening {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}). The root field of help, support, and victory gives the Christian label an allegiance resonance, while the local referent remains the named community. It participates in the inherited community formula of 2:62, 5:69, and 22:17, and the same support root later returns in Sūrah 22 as aid vocabulary rather than as this community name.

topics.headline: named Christian group in the accusative list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Christian group is institutionally named in the nominal middle section while remaining inside the same governed list.
topics.reason: The word is a definite community noun coordinated in the accusative enumeration.

topics.headline: helper field behind the label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears support and helper resonance behind the label, while the local wording still names Christians rather than generic helpers.

topics.headline: formula label with later aid vocabulary

topics.reason: The rows give concrete recurrence and same-root distribution signals.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the Magian hapax to the same list
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) admits the Magian label into the same coordinate chain. The conjunction matters because the next word is a hapax and foreign community name; it is not left exotic or isolated but grammatically absorbed into the field God will separate.

topics.headline: foreign label joined to same verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the hapax foreign community is put on the same syntactic footing as the better-known labels.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the hapax community noun with the preceding governed list.

words.gloss_range: definite Magian community label, a foreign or loan term, accusative in the list
words.root_gloss_range: not a productive local Arabic root field here; supplied evidence treats it as a fixed Persian-derived community name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَجُوسَ}} ({{tr:al-majūsa}}) is grammatically absorbed as an accusative coordinate, but lexically it resists ordinary Arabic derivation as a fixed foreign community name. Its payoff is specificity: the verse names Magians as a concrete ritual community, not merely a vague religious other. Because this is the sole Quranic occurrence, its placement in 22:17 makes the inherited 2:62 and 5:69 list visibly broader.

topics.headline: fixed loan community in Arabic syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a foreign, hapax community name fully absorbed into the Arabic case chain.
topics.reason: QAC places the word as a definite accusative coordinate, while the lexical rows mark it as a Persian-derived fixed community label.

topics.headline: concrete ritual community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the list reaches a named Magian community rather than an empty category of otherness.
topics.reason: The rows identify the word as a specific community label with cross-linguistic reach.

topics.headline: sole occurrence broadens the formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes 22:17 as the place where the earlier 2:62 and 5:69 community formula expands to include this sole Quranic Magian label.
topics.reason: The distribution rows identify the word as occurring once and as extending the inherited list.

words.gloss_range: final coordinating conjunction before the last relative-clause group
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) closes the enumeration by adding the final relative-clause group to the same chain. It keeps the associators from becoming an afterthought: they are the last coordinate member exposed to the same divine separation.

topics.headline: last group joined before judgment

topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final relative phrase with the prior list.

words.gloss_range: final definite relative pronoun making associators an action-defined class
words.prose: The final {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) returns to the relative-clause pattern after the nominal middle. It defines the last group by the completed act of association rather than by a bare plural label, making it parallel to the earlier action-defined communities.

topics.headline: associators defined by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final community is built from a relative clause and a verb, matching the opening action-defined groups.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the final verb that defines the group.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural: they associated or assigned partnership, with the object unexpressed
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, participation, and assigning partners; local Form IV selects imposed theological association

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening action-defined belief/trust verb in the list

words.prose: {{ar:أَشْرَكُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ashrakū}}) closes the list with a perfect plural act parallel to the earlier action-defined verbs. Its object is unexpressed, so the charge of association stands broadly rather than pointing to one named partner. The root's concrete partnership field matters because Form IV makes the subject assign or cause partnership, not merely participate mutually. As the final item it forms a polarity with {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}): the list runs from trust-giving to authority-sharing before God separates between them. Same-surah reuse at 22:31 moves the root into a conditional warning, while 22:17 uses it as one completed group identity.

topics.headline: completed association with object unstated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final group is defined by a completed association-act whose object is deliberately left broad.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect plural Form IV with no expressed object in the local clause.

topics.headline: sharing field becomes imposed association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the concrete partnership field behind the theological charge, while Form IV specifies assigning partnership rather than mutual sharing.
topics.reason: The root field includes shared participation, but the local Form IV selects causative or assigned association.

topics.headline: spectrum from trust to association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sixfold list framed by a polarity between trusting commitment and assigning partners before the singular divine judge appears.
topics.reason: The final verb is contrasted with the opening belief verb and is immediately followed by the divine judgment clause.

topics.headline: local root recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the completed group label here with later same-surah warning and sanctuary-purity language at 22:26 and 22:31.
topics.reason: The rows give same-surah recurrence and boundary evidence for the root's local role.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: second emphatic particle reopening assertion after the long enumeration
words.prose: The second {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) is the hinge from inventory to verdict. After the long six-group subject, it reopens emphatic predication with God as subject and the separation verb as the operative claim. The grammar can be heard both as completing the first {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) and as a fresh assertion, which is exactly why it resets the listener before judgment is named.

topics.headline: inventory turns into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact hinge where the catalog stops being inventory and becomes divine adjudication.
topics.reason: The second inna-clause follows the enumeration and opens the divine separation predicate.

topics.headline: delayed predicate and renewed claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the repeated particle both resolves the opening suspension and re-engages attention for the verdict.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows preserve the grammatical ambiguity while local syntax supports the rhetorical reset.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name as the subject of the second inna-clause
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with worship/devotion and bewilderment analyses in contested derivational background; local function centers the named God as judge
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) names the singular divine subject of the separation clause after the plural human taxonomy. The accusative proper name is not a generic deity term or descriptive epithet; it centers the verdict on the named God. The contested derivational background keeps worship/devotion and bewilderment in view, while the local grammar still makes the proper name the judge. Its repeated pairing with the later {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) binds judge and witness roles, and parallels such as 22:69 and 22:56 show the same divine-name judgment field from another angle.

topics.headline: singular named judge after plural list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sharp move from many human communities to one named divine judge.
topics.reason: The word is the accusative ism of the second inna-clause and precedes the separation verb.

topics.headline: proper name with worship-root background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the worship/devotion and bewilderment analyses in view without replacing the local proper-name function.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is relevant background, but the local lexical unit functions as the proper divine name.

topics.headline: same name binds verdict and warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the subject who separates is the same named subject later presented as witness.
topics.reason: The divine name recurs as the subject of both the verdict and warrant clauses.

topics.headline: same-surah judgment field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this divine judgment clause with 22:69 and 22:56, where similar judgment-day language is configured with different judgment vocabulary.
topics.reason: The rows cite concrete same-surah parallels involving the divine name and judgment-day language.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect: he separates or decides, completed locally by between them and temporally by the Day of Resurrection
words.root_gloss_range: separating, cutting apart, distinguishing, judging, detailing, and sectioning; local Form I selects decisive separation/judgment
words.prose: {{ar:يَفْصِلُ}} ({{tr:yafṣilu}}) is the single verb that resolves the long suspended subject-list. Though the event is anchored to the Day of Resurrection, the imperfect form makes the future judgment vivid and present. Its root joins physical separation with judicial decision, so God's verdict is not only announced; the listed groups are actively distinguished between. The standard Form I gives a decisive separation in the between-space, while the reported Form II reading would make that same domain sound like distributed detailed articulation. The verb also activates the Day-of-Decision field named at 37:21, 44:40, 77:13-14, and 78:17, and it answers the boundary from clear signs in 22:16 by turning clarity into separation.

topics.headline: future judgment in imperfect form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one imperfect verb gathers the whole list into a vivid future judgment scene.
topics.reason: The word is an imperfect active Form I verb and supplies the operative predicate after the sixfold list.

topics.headline: separation completed by between them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verb's judgment operates in the relation-space among the listed groups, not on a simple direct object.
topics.reason: The following adverbial phrase supplies the domain in which separation happens.

topics.headline: decision as active separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels judgment as a concrete separating act rather than an abstract declaration.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports both physical separation and judicial deciding, and the local clause activates both.

topics.headline: decisive separation versus detailed articulation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the standard reading as decisive separation while the accepted variant offers a contrastive model of detailed articulation.
topics.reason: The canonical local form is Form I, while the variant reading is useful contrast but does not govern the base parse.

topics.headline: verb enacts the Day title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this separation verb with the Day-of-Decision formula at 37:21, 44:40, 77:13-14, and 78:17.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite the concrete formulaic references for the same root field.

topics.headline: clarity becomes separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the transition from clarified signs in 22:16 to active separation in 22:17.
topics.reason: The boundary and sound rows provide a concrete local transition and phonetic observation.

words.gloss_range: adverbial between-space with third-person plural suffix referring to all six groups
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, distinction, clarity, and manifest proof; local form gives the separation verb its relational domain
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}) gives the separation verb its space: judgment happens between the listed communities. The suffix compresses all six named groups into one plural referent, turning the long catalog into the domain of divine distinction. Because the root field also includes clarity and manifestation, the between-space is also where differences become evident; this continues the movement from the open who of 22:16 into a concrete plural field in 22:17.

topics.headline: all six groups compressed into one suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the long list is gathered into one plural suffix as the space where judgment occurs.
topics.reason: The noun/adverb carries a third-person plural suffix whose antecedent is the six-group enumeration.

topics.headline: separation-space is clarity-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the interval not as empty space but as the place where disputed distinctions become clear.
topics.reason: The root evidence links between-ness, separation, and clarity, and the local phrase is governed by the separation verb.

topics.headline: open who becomes concrete them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 22:16's open human referent become the concrete plural field separated in 22:17.
topics.reason: The rows track the referent movement from the prior ayah into the suffixal plural here.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal adverb and construct head of the Resurrection phrase
words.root_gloss_range: day, bounded time, period, epoch, and event-zone; local construct phrase selects the eschatological Day

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the separation verb modified by the temporal phrase

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) answers when the separation occurs: it is the accusative time-adverb for {{ar:يَفْصِلُ}} ({{tr:yafṣilu}}). At the same time it is a construct head bound to {{ar:ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ}} ({{tr:al-qiyāmati}}), so the broad word for a bounded time is narrowed to the Day of Resurrection. The root range allows a day to be an event-zone or epoch rather than only a daylight cycle; in 22:17 it joins the surah's wider judgment-day timing network, including 22:2, 22:9, 22:47, 22:55, and 22:56.

topics.headline: when the separation happens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the separation is temporally anchored, not left as an ongoing undated process.
topics.reason: The word is accusative as an adverb of time modifying the separation verb.

topics.headline: construct head narrows the time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the broad day-word is formally dependent on the Resurrection noun, making the time specifically eschatological.
topics.reason: The word is in construct with the following genitive noun.

topics.headline: day as bounded event-zone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the Day as a bounded judgment event-zone, while the construct phrase fixes the specific eschatological referent.
topics.reason: The broader root range allows period or epoch senses, but local idafa selects the Day of Resurrection.

topics.headline: surah-wide eschatological timing

words.gloss_range: genitive proper day-name in construct with yawma: the Resurrection
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, straightening, valuation, and community; local noun names the eschatological standing/rising event
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ}} ({{tr:al-qiyāmati}}) completes the construct phrase and fixes the separation's time as the Resurrection, not a generic rising. Its root names standing and rising, so the event is imagined as the standing in which all communities face distinction. The wider root family adds evaluation and straightening pressure, and its community-language edge lets the many listed peoples be heard as groups standing for distinction; the local definite proper day-name still keeps the referent eschatological. Its pairing with the separation root makes a judgment field where standing and separating meet.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the time phrase is pinned to the named Resurrection, not a generic day or rising.
topics.reason: The word is genitive as the construct complement of the preceding temporal noun and functions as a definite proper day-name.

topics.headline: resurrection as standing

topics.reason: The root evidence and verbal noun form support the standing/rising image for the named event.

topics.headline: standing tied to evaluation and groups

topics.reason: Related root branches add evaluation and group resonance but do not replace the local eschatological referent.

topics.headline: standing field meets separation field

topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows link the standing root with the separation root across judgment contexts.

words.gloss_range: third emphatic particle opening the witness-warrant clause
words.prose: The third {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the closing warrant, not a detached praise formula. After the list and verdict, it grounds the divine separation by asserting that God is witness over every thing. This completes the ayah's triple-emphasis movement from claim to action to epistemic ground, and it sharpens the boundary from 22:16's open guidance-will frame into juridical certainty.

topics.headline: final clause grounds the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause explains why the separation is authoritative: it rests on universal witness.
topics.reason: The third inna governs the divine name and takes the witness predicate with its universal domain.

topics.reason: The row family links the third inna to the ayah's three-stage architecture and to the boundary escalation.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name as subject of the final witness clause
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with worship/devotion derivational background; local function names the same God as universal witness
words.prose: The final {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) repeats the divine subject from the verdict clause, now as the subject of universal witnessing. That repetition makes the separator and the witness the same agent. The co-occurrence with {{ar:شَهِيدٌ}} ({{tr:shahīdun}}) is formulaic, and the two divine-name occurrences form a local ring around adjudication and warrant.

topics.headline: same named subject as witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause does not introduce a new agent; the same named God is now witness over every thing.
topics.reason: The word is the accusative ism of the third inna-clause and forms the divine-witness collocation.

topics.headline: proper-name background in witness clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the proper-name question tied to witnessing as well as judgment, without replacing the local name with an etymology.
topics.reason: The row's root/proper-name issue remains relevant because the local role is witness, but the surface is still the proper divine name.

topics.headline: repetition binds two divine roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two divine-name clauses as a ring: God separates, and God witnesses the whole field.
topics.reason: The rows identify the repeated divine name at words 17 and 23 as binding the verdict and warrant clauses.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the universal domain of the witness predicate
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) governs the universal domain before the witness predicate is named. Its placement fronts the scope over every thing, and its normal over/upon force makes divine witnessing sound like authoritative oversight rather than bare observation.

topics.headline: universal scope before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the universal domain is placed before the witness predicate, so scope is heard first.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes and constrains the final predicate.

topics.headline: witnessing as authority over
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels divine witness as authoritative oversight over every thing, not only contact with evidence.
topics.reason: The preposition's local governance of the witness domain supports the authority frame.

words.gloss_range: construct universal quantifier: every, each, all
words.root_gloss_range: totality, wholeness, exhaustion, and every-member distribution; local construct with an indefinite noun selects distributive universality
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) is the construct head that makes the witness domain distributive. With the following indefinite noun, it means every member of the class, not a vague collective whole. That turns the warrant for separation into item-by-item universality: no entity, event, or community falls outside the scope. The phrase also belongs to a recognizable divine-witness formula.

topics.headline: each-and-every scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witness scope is distributive and item-by-item, not an undifferentiated totality.
topics.reason: The word is a construct head followed by an indefinite genitive noun, yielding distributive universality.

topics.headline: nothing outside witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the witness clause as covering no limited subset, but the unrestricted set that grounds judgment.
topics.reason: The quantifier plus maximally general noun creates unrestricted scope.

topics.headline: universal witness formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing phrase as formulaic divine-witness language where universality and testimony converge.
topics.reason: The contextual rows identify the quantifier, thing noun, and witness predicate as a recurring formulaic field.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive noun completing the universal construct: thing, entity, affair, matter
words.root_gloss_range: thingness, existence, affair, and possible derivation from willing; local indefinite noun keeps the object class maximally open
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) completes the universal construct as an indefinite genitive, leaving the witness-domain maximally open. It is the broad noun for thing, entity, affair, or matter, so the clause is not limited to the six communities just named. The possible relation to willing can make thingness feel like willed existence, but locally the main force is unrestricted scope. In the recurring formula found at 4:33, 22:17, 33:55, and 58:6, the universal object and witness predicate together ground the separation.

topics.headline: any thing whatsoever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witness clause reaches beyond the six groups to any entity, affair, or matter whatsoever.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite, genitive, and governed by the universal construct head.

topics.headline: thingness and willing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear thingness as potentially linked to willed existence, while the local phrase mainly functions as an unrestricted object class.
topics.reason: The derivational pressure is plausible but should not override the local quantifier construction.

topics.headline: formula grounds separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word as part of a recurring universal-witness formula at 4:33, 22:17, 33:55, and 58:6 that supplies the epistemic warrant for judgment.
topics.reason: The rows cite concrete formulaic references and explain the relation between total scope and witness capacity.

topics.headline: same-surah universality thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this witness clause with same-surah universality claims at 22:1, 22:18, 22:26, and 22:73.
topics.reason: The contextual row gives concrete same-surah references for the root's universalizing role.

words.gloss_range: nominative indefinite faʿīl predicate: witness, fully present testifier
words.root_gloss_range: witnessing, testimony, presence, attestation, and martyrdom; local divine predicate selects stable comprehensive witness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the third emphatic particle opening the witness-warrant clause

words.prose: {{ar:شَهِيدٌ}} ({{tr:shahīdun}}) is the nominative predicate of the final {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), characterizing God as witness rather than identifying Him as one limited witness. Its faʿīl form differs from a simple active participle and makes witnessing a stable, intensified attribute suited to the phrase over every thing. The testimony field adds presence as well as evidence, while the human martyr sense remains background and does not govern the divine predicate. The epithet recurs in divine-witness contexts such as 3:98, 4:33, 4:166, 10:46, 41:53, and 85:9; within Sūrah 22 it answers the believers-as-witnesses scene at 22:78. The final tanwīn cadence links the universal object and witness predicate, and the triple-{{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) frame lands here as the warrant for the whole separation.

topics.headline: witness as characterizing predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final predicate characterizes God with witnesshood rather than limiting Him to one identified witness role.
topics.reason: The word is nominative indefinite as the predicate of the final inna-clause.

topics.headline: stable intensified witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels witnesshood here as stable presence and testimony, not a one-off observation.
topics.reason: The faʿīl pattern and testimony-family evidence support an intensified divine witness predicate.

topics.headline: martyr sense kept as background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the broader testimony field in view while recognizing that the local divine predicate is comprehensive witness, not human martyrdom.
topics.reason: The lexical field includes martyr usage, but the local subject and universal domain select divine witnessing.

topics.headline: divine witness and later believer witnesses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links this divine witness epithet with recurring witness contexts such as 3:98, 4:33, 4:166, 10:46, 41:53, and 85:9, and with the believer-witness role movement at 22:78.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete cross-surah and same-surah witness-field references.

topics.headline: final sound and structural warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final predicate as both the sound closure and the theological warrant for the ayah's three-part structure.
topics.reason: The sound, boundary, and synthesis rows all locate the final witness predicate as the closure of the ayah's warrant frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated emphatic construction lists six affiliations before saying that God will separate or decide between them on the Day of Rising.
baseline_models.mechanism: The list gathers unlike parties into one pending case. The judicial branch of f-s-l makes the future separation a decision, bayn keeps the parties in a shared relational field, and the Day of Rising fixes when that pending distinction becomes operative.

activation_trace.role: Judicial decision that cuts truth from falsehood turns the enumeration into a pending docket rather than an already executed partition.
The interval or middle between parties keeps all named groups inside one adjudicable relation before their distinction.
A day understood as a grave event gives the decision event-scale force rather than ordinary calendrical timing.
Rising and resurrection identify the event as the standing of creatures for the deferred decision.

changed_reading.before: A flat taxonomy of religions followed by a generic promise of future separation.
changed_reading.after: A provisional docket of heterogeneous parties held together until a future judicial differentiation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The enumeration alternates verbal descriptions such as believing and associating with bare communal names.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventory prevents the six items from functioning as equivalent labels. Settled assent is an inward disposition, Christianity and Magianism are explicit affiliations, and association is an enacted relation. Divine separation must therefore distinguish kinds of attachment and action, not merely sort six matching denominations.

activation_trace.role: Assent in which the heart settles makes the first item a lived disposition rather than only a group name.
Explicit religious affiliation supplies one genuinely communal-name item in the mixed enumeration.
A religion, adherence to it, or induction into it supplies another affiliation whose social formation differs from inward assent.
Making a partner for God makes the final item an enacted theological relation, not simply a proper-name community.

changed_reading.after: An intentionally uneven inventory of inward assent, communal affiliation, and enacted association whose differences still require adjudication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah closes by making God witness over every thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The whole gathers every part, a thing is whatever can be known and reported, and witnessing joins present observation to knowledgeable declaration. The verdict therefore has a particularized evidentiary scope that exceeds every collective label.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive enclosure of all parts prevents any deed, state, or person from falling outside the evidentiary field.
The knowable and reportable particular supplies the unit over which comprehensive witnessing ranges.
Presence with observation gives the final predicate direct evidentiary contact with every particular.
Knowledgeable declaration turns observation into testimony capable of grounding the announced decision.

changed_reading.before: A conventional assertion of divine omniscience after the group list.
changed_reading.after: An evidentiary guarantee that every knowable particular, not collective identity alone, is present to the final decision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The edge-worshipper settles when benefit arrives but reverses under trial. This supplies a perturbation test for the focus list: nominal proximity to worship is unstable, while the believing predicate can now be heard against heart-settled trust that survives a change of conditions.

activation_trace.role: Heart-level security and trust provide the stable orientation against which edge-dependent worship can be tested.
Deviation from a direction makes the literal edge a precarious orientation rather than a secure location.
Testing a person as metal is tested supplies the pressure that reveals whether an apparent affiliation holds.
Turning a thing away from its face gives the trial an observable reversal that exposes unstable orientation.

structural_cues: 22:11 sequences worship on an edge, benefit, trial, and a turn back on the face.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge-position, testing, and reversal; I read their sequence as a diagnostic of the stability behind the focus's believing predicate. A live alternative is that 22:11 describes one unstable type without revising how any focus group is judged.

changed_reading.before: Future separation operates primarily on the affiliations named in the list.
changed_reading.after: Future separation also exposes stable and edge-dependent orientations that can cut across nominal affiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dominant mapped branch behind h-w-d is repeatedly activated as actual guidance: God guides, people are guided to good speech, and they are guided to a praised path. The focus label remains a communal name, but it now sits inside a surah-wide directional process rather than exhausting the meaning of guidance.

activation_trace.role: Direction, course, and intended way make the focus label available to a trajectory reading without replacing its communal function.
Gentle indication toward path and truth introduces guidance as an active divine direction immediately before the focus.
Repeated direction toward truth makes guidance an achieved movement with two stated destinations.
Articulated speech supplies the first practical destination by making guided direction audible in good saying.
A straight road supplies the second destination and turns guidance into a sustained course.

structural_cues: Guidance recurs at 22:16, 22:24, 22:37, 22:54, and 22:67 as divine direction, speech, and path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared mapped root and repeated path-directed guidance; I let that process resonate with the focus label while retaining the label's conventional communal reference. The live alternative is that no semantic traffic should pass from the contextual h-d-y forms into h-w-d.

changed_reading.before: Those who h-w-d function only as one fixed communal entry.
changed_reading.after: The fixed entry also activates a directional question: how a named community relates to guidance enacted as speech and path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, the frame widens from named human affiliations to a cosmos that bows, then divides the human many between enacted submission and incurred consequence. The six-group list becomes a local human cross-section inside a larger field of creaturely alignment.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion allows the focus's every-thing scope to open onto the following inventory of cosmic participants.
Presence with observation lets enacted cosmic posture function as visible evidence within the wider field.
Bodily lowering and submission supply an enacted alignment that crosses the listed human labels.
Numerical abundance marks two large human outcomes inside the otherwise cosmos-wide submission.

structural_cues: 22:18 expands through heavens, earth, celestial bodies, terrain, plants, animals, and two occurrences of 'many' among people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, cosmic enumeration, bodily submission, and a divided human many; I treat these as the larger alignment field in which the focus list is assessed. The alternative is that 22:18 merely changes topic after completing the intercommunal judgment statement.

changed_reading.before: The focus classifies religious communities within an exclusively human comparison.
changed_reading.after: The human list is nested in a creature-wide economy where enacted alignment, not labels alone, becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sanctuary is made equal for resident and outsider; every community is assigned a rite; the deity is one; and renewed mention of every community is paired with refusal of ritual contest. These cues preserve differentiated communal practices under a common divine axis while reserving the focus's final separation for God.

activation_trace.role: Judicial differentiation anchors the model in a decision that belongs to God rather than a present human exclusion.
Equality between two parties supplies equal sacred access across the resident and outsider distinction.
A community as a religion or way gives communal plurality a recognized procedural form.
A ritual place and its practice supply the differentiated rite assigned to each community.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the single axis that does not require erasing distinct communal rites.
Mutual pulling between parties renders ritual dispute as a contest the addressee is told not to let control the matter.

structural_cues: 22:25 pairs sacred space with equality between resident and outsider.
22:34 and 22:67 repeat 'for every community' with a rite, while 22:67 moves from that plurality to non-contestation and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal access, community-specific rites, divine oneness, and restraint of contest; I infer that these constrain 'separates between them' against present social exclusion. A live alternative is that equality concerns sanctuary logistics only and that the assigned rites do not imply any broader recognition.

changed_reading.before: Religious difference points directly toward social separation.
changed_reading.after: Distinct rites can coexist under one divine axis and equal sacred access, while final adjudication remains God's task.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's comprehensive divine witness is joined by pilgrims who come to witness benefits and, at the surah's close, by the messenger and community bearing witness over people. Witnessing thus ranges from presence and encounter to accountable testimony, with divine witness remaining the encompassing apex.

activation_trace.role: Knowledgeable declaration anchors every derivative human witness role in comprehensive divine testimony.
Presence with observation makes human witnessing participatory encounter with concrete benefits rather than detached surveillance.
The messenger and message provide the commissioned position from which the first human testimony is borne.
Knowledgeable testimony links the messenger's witness over the community to the community's witness over people.

structural_cues: 22:28 uses witnessing for attending benefits, while 22:78 forms a messenger-community-people sequence of witness roles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three human uses of the same witness root; I infer an accountable chain under the focus's comprehensive divine witness, not a transfer or reduction of divine knowledge. The alternative is that pilgrimage attendance and testimonial office are only homonymous contextual uses.

changed_reading.before: God's witness is a solitary closing assertion of surveillance.
changed_reading.after: God's encompassing witness also frames participatory encounter and commissioned human testimony within the surah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Permission to resist follows wrongful expulsion, and reciprocal human checking is said to prevent demolition of several kinds of worship sites. The aid branch latent in the focus's Nasara label is then enacted repeatedly as divine help. Final differentiation among communities therefore coexists with historical protection of their worship spaces.

activation_trace.role: Christian affiliation fixes the focus anchor whose same root inventory can later activate aid without replacing the communal name.
Deflecting harm supplies the protective function of reciprocal human checking.
Casting down a building supplies the concrete destruction that the protective mechanism prevents.
A Christian worship place identifies one protected sanctuary as belonging to a focus-listed community.
A place of prostration supplies another distinct protected worship space in the same counterfactual list.
Aid and making one prevail enact the assistance branch twice after the protected-site sequence.

structural_cues: 22:39 grounds permission in being wronged, and 22:40 names monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in one prevented-demolition sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrongful expulsion, defensive checking, prevented demolition, plural worship sites, and repeated help; I infer that these limit the focus's separation against historical erasure. The alternative is that protection attaches only to places where God's name is much mentioned, not to every institution or doctrine.

changed_reading.before: Future differentiation can be heard as continuous with present removal of rival communities.
changed_reading.after: Final divine differentiation is compatible with, and contextually paired with, worldly defense of multiple communities' worship spaces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later formulations repeat the focus's between-construction with explicit ruling, the Day of Rising, and the matters in which people took different paths. A final book cue adds a durable record. These parallels specify the focus's f-s-l as evidence-based adjudication of disagreement while leaving its boundary-making force intact.

activation_trace.role: Judicial separation of truth from falsehood supplies the focus mechanism later made explicit by ruling language.
The shared interval between parties provides the relational frame repeated in both later rulings.
Judgment between people directly glosses the earlier separation as a ruling.
A second judgment between people on the Day of Rising makes the judicial parallel exact and recurrent.
Each party taking a path unlike another identifies disagreement as the object of the ruling.
The written record supplies durable inscription for the comprehensive knowledge invoked after the ruling.

structural_cues: 22:56 says that God rules between them.
22:69 repeats God, ruling, between, and the Day of Rising, then names what people differed about; 22:70 places total knowledge in a book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two direct ruling parallels and an explicit object of disagreement; I take them as specification of the directional arrow already available in f-s-l. The live alternative is that the focus's separation remains broader than formal adjudication even though judgment is one of its mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: God will separate named communities in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: God will adjudicate the matters on which parties diverged, on a complete evidentiary record, and thereby establish their real boundaries.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers nursing and birth mechanics into intercommunal judgment. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus inventory gives f-s-l a literal weaning branch and 22:2 makes every nursing bond fail while every pregnancy releases its load on that day. Render it only as an analogy for attachments being stripped, never as a claim that communities are biological offspring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb yَفْsilu and its weaning branch, fixed to the Day of Rising.

activation_trace.role: A child or suckling separated from mother or nursing supplies the focus-side material model of compelled detachment.
A nursing relation that functions like kinship supplies the attachment that the day disrupts.
Putting down a pregnancy by birth supplies the forced release paired with failed nursing.
The inward-carried load supplies what is released when ordinary bonds and containers no longer hold.

changed_reading.before: Eschatological separation is only legal sorting.
changed_reading.after: It can also be pictured, cautiously, as catastrophic weaning or birth from inherited attachments before judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus's non-dominant h-d-d mapping rather than the expected guidance mapping. It remains packet-anchored because that split inventory explicitly includes severe breaking and demolition, while 22:40 supplies actual building-demolition language inside a mechanism that prevents it. Render this only as a form-distant acoustic branch echo, never as the etymology or definition of the Jewish community.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus form h-w-d has an explicit secondary mapping to h-d-d alongside its dominant h-d-y mapping.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition make a remote destructive resonance available inside the focus label's split inventory.
Deflection of harm reverses the destructive resonance by making prevention, not demolition, the operative action.
Casting down a building supplies the context's concrete near-neighbor to the focus inventory's remote demolition image.
A Christian worship place locates the demolition danger within the plural religious landscape named by the focus.

changed_reading.before: The h-w-d item activates only a communal label and its guidance-side mapping.
changed_reading.after: A contained secondary echo makes threatened demolition audible around the label, only for the surah's defensive mechanism to block that destruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a night-day material process into the boundaries among communities. It remains anchored in the focus's f-s-l and bayn constructions and in 22:61's repeated insertion of each temporal domain into the other. Render it as an anti-essentialist spatial analogy showing that divine distinction need not mean sealed substances, not as a claim that doctrines merge or that judgment disappears.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: God separates between the parties, combining boundary-making with a relation that still stands between them.

activation_trace.role: Making a boundary visible supplies the distinction whose material character is being tested.
A connection standing between endpoints keeps relation alive even where distinction is made.
One thing entering inside another supplies a divine boundary process based on reciprocal interpenetration.
Night as the dark contrary of day supplies one distinct domain that nevertheless enters and is entered.
Daylight opening supplies the contrary domain whose boundary with night remains dynamic rather than sealed.

changed_reading.before: Separation implies fixed, mutually sealed communal blocks.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, divine differentiation can establish real boundaries while relations and transitions remain active across them.

strongest_changes: The direct parallels at 22:56 and 22:69 specify the focus's f-s-l as deferred adjudication of actual disagreement on a comprehensive record.

Equal sanctuary access, community-specific rites under one God, restraint of ritual contest, and protection of plural worship sites prevent final separation from becoming a warrant for present exclusion or erasure.
Witnessing expands from God's comprehensive evidentiary presence to pilgrim encounter and commissioned messenger-community testimony.
Repeated h-d-y contexts make guidance an enacted trajectory around the fixed h-w-d communal label.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated both sides of the h-w-d split: a sustained guidance trajectory on the dominant h-d-y side and, much more cautiously, a demolition echo on the h-d-d side that 22:40 immediately reverses through protection. It also made the focus's weaning branch of f-s-l unexpectedly live through the nursing and pregnancy collapse of 22:2.
remaining_uncertainties: The equal-access and assigned-rite cues constrain social handling of difference, but they do not by themselves establish doctrinal equivalence.
The witness sequence may be a true accountability chain or several context-specific uses of one root.
The weaning, demolition, and night-day readings are branch-driven analogies and must not be promoted into lexical definitions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Judgment as articulation between intermingled claims.** `ف ص ل B001/B002` is separation and judgment between truth and falsehood; `ب ي ن B002/B003` supplies both interval and connection; `ش ه د B001/B002` presence and informed testimony. The inventory of affiliations is held together until the event-day of separation. I infer that perfect witnessing permits distinctions without collapsing groups into labels alone. Divine judgment reads as articulation of what is actually between and within the named communities.
2. **Religious identities as movements, not inert nouns.** `ه و د B001/B002` includes turning back and Jewish affiliation; `ص ب ء B001/B002` emergence and religious exit; `ش ر ك B001/B002` partnership and associating partners. Their juxtaposition foregrounds acts of turning, exiting, and sharing beneath communal names. I infer that separation judges operative orientations as witnessed realities. The list can therefore be read dynamically while preserving its explicit group references.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:67 returned communal rites explicitly: their plurality is affirmed, contention is refused, and judgment of difference is deferred to 22:69.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Differentiation after shared exposure.** Fixed `يَفْصِل` activates `ف ص ل:B002` (judgment separating truth from falsehood), while `بَيْنَهُم` activates `ب ي ن:B002` (the interval between things) and `شَهِيد` activates `ش ه د:B001` (presence with witnessing). The enumerated communities are followed in `22:18` by a cosmos sharing submission while humanity remains divided. The packet supplies plurality, common field, and later separation; I infer that adjudication distinguishes within what has first been fully present to the witness. The ayah reads as precise separation, not flattening of groups into one category.
2. **The event-day is a rising into adjudication.** Fixed `يَوْم` permits `ي و م:B003` (event-day) and `ٱلْقِيَامَة` activates `ق و م:B013` (resurrection and rising of the Hour). Their adjacency makes the temporal marker itself a transition from latent difference to standing judgment. I infer that the event reveals relations now held in suspension. The day is read functionally as the occasion when distinctions stand forth.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:18` unexpectedly places all listed communities inside a wider field of cosmic submission before human divergence is sorted, making `يَفْصِل` precise adjudication within shared exposure.

findings.text: Farklı topluluklar yan yana anılsa da kesin ayrım, ortak görünüşten sonra iddiaları birbirinden açıkça ayıran yargıya bırakılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal dogrulama ve kabullenme kutbunda, komsu dal ise hakikati reddetme veya ortme kutbundadir; bu nedenle ayni eksende karsit dururlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir haber veya hakikate kabul ve tasdikle yonelir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de zihinsel kabul ve dogru sayma alanina yaklasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal kesinlik derecesini ve belirtiye dayali bilgiyi vurgular; bu dal ise kabul etme ve dogrulama eylemine odaklanir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dogru sayma, haber ya da hakikati kabul etme eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de kalpte tutulan kabul veya gorusle ilgili olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal kanaatin baglanmis ve sabit hale gelmesini anlatir; bu dal dogrulama ve kabul iliskisini esas alir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tasdik, haberin veya hakikatin dogru kabul edilmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kalbin yatismasi iki dalda da eslik edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda yatiskinlik dogru sayma ve kabullenmeden gelir; komsu dalda yatiskinlik korku ve tehlike ihtimalinin kalkmasindan gelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul talebi ve onu soyleme eylemi icin genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Dua baglamini, kabul istegini ve sabit soz niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sozun dua icindeki anlamini eylemli bicimde cevirmek gerektiginde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Sabit soz ve onu soyleme eylemi olma tarafini eksiltir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duanin sonucuna katilma ve gerceklesmesini dileme baglaminda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabul ve gerceklesme istegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ilahi muhataba yonelen talep kuvvetini ve sozu soyleme eylemini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem adi olan kullanimda, yani bu sozu telaffuz etme anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sozu soyleme eylemini ve dua baglamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sozun tek basina anlamini ve ad yorumu yanini kapsamaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan bir armağanı ya da yalnızca yolun kendisini değil, doğru yönü bildirme ve ona yönelme ilişkisini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki armağan, adanmış sunu ve özel kullanım anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yolu, doğruyu ya da benimsenmesi gereken yönü incelikle göstermek ve tanıtmak; gösterilen yönü kabul ederek doğruya ulaşmak, ayrıca bunun ilahi başarı desteğiyle gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönü gösterme, yolu tanıtma ve yanılgının karşıtı olan doğruya erişme çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatım, insanın gösterileni seçip benimsemesini ve ilahi başarı desteğini de içerir. Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

concept_gloss.text: doğru yolu gösterme ve doğruya yönelme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun veya gerçeğin bildirilmesiyle başlayıp gösterilen doğru yönün benimsenmesine uzanan bütün çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gösterme, tanıtma, benimseme ve doğruya ulaşma basamaklarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye somut ya da düşünsel bir yolun tanıtıldığı geçişlerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yolu bildirme ve kişiyi doğru yöne sevk etme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gösterileni benimseme ve ilahi başarı desteği yönlerini tek başına anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gösterilen yönü kabul edip doğruya ulaşan kişinin durumunu anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğru yönü benimseyerek ona ulaşma sonucunu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasının yolu gösterme eylemini ve ilahi başarı desteğini belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği bir yönü gösterme ve gösterilen yönü benimseme ilişkisidir; komşu dal ise doğru olma ve doğru yolda bulunma niteliğini daha geniş biçimde taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yönün bulunmasını ve benimsenmesini bildirirken komşu dal o yönden ayrılmayı ve yolunu yitirmeyi bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir işin yönünü ve amacını, kişinin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve yöntemini, ayrıca sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmamayı birlikte verir. Verilen çerçeve bu çok parçalı fakat bağlantılı kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca genel bir yaşam tarzı değildir; yön ve amaç bildiren kullanımlarla belirli bir işte veya söylemde kalma kullanımını da içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yön, gidiş ve tutum bildiren biçimler ile kalıplaşmış benzerlik ve yineleme kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; özel kullanımlar çıplak kökün tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yönü, amacı ve izlenen doğrultusu ile bir kimsenin gidişi, görünür tutumu ve yöntemidir. Belirli anlatımlarda yürütülen söz ya da işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme, ona benzeme veya aynı karşılığı yineleme anlamı kazanır.

facets.statement: Bir işin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu bildirir.
Bir kimsenin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve izlediği yöntemi anlatır.
Sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmama ve başkasının izlediği yolu izleme kullanımını içerir.
Özel bir söyleyişte benzerini verme veya aynı işi yeniden yapma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı yön ve amaç ile kişinin izlediği yol ve görünür tutumu aynı kavramsal alanda toplar; sürmekte olan işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme ve özel bir söyleyişte benzerini ya da tekrarını yapma kullanımları buna bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin doğrultusunu ve bir kişinin davranış biçimini birlikte karşılayan genel kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön, amaç, yöntem, görünür tutum ve izlenen gidiş çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هدي الأمر أو هديته بمعنى جهته ووجهته وقصده وسيرته وطريقته وسمته وما يلازم ذلك من لزوم الحديث أو العمل والمماثلة في هدياها
